title: SAM-V: Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Consistent multi-view object segmentation is critical for 3D perception and robotics, yet remains challenging under severe viewpoint and occlusion changes. Existing methods typically perform 3D instance segmentation on point clouds or rely on offline 2D mask-matching pipelines. However, 3D instance segmentation is limited by scarce 3D annotations, while offline 2D matching suffers from object identity ambiguity across frames. To leverage strong 2D and 3D priors jointly, we propose SAM-V (Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation). Instead of combining the two priors through post-hoc matching, SAM-V directly integrates features from a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into a 2D segmentation foundation model (SAM), trained end-to-end for cross-view instance prediction. translated_title: SAM-V：面向多视角实例分割的几何感知Segment Anything
translated_abstract: 一致的多视角物体分割对于3D感知和机器人技术至关重要，但在剧烈的视角变化和遮挡情况下仍然极具挑战性。现有方法通常在点云上执行3D实例分割，或依赖离线的2D掩码匹配流水线。然而，3D实例分割受限于稀缺的3D标注，而离线2D匹配则存在跨帧物体身份歧义的问题。为了联合利用强大的2D和3D先验，我们提出了SAM-V（面向多视角实例分割的几何感知Segment Anything）。SAM-V不再通过事后匹配来结合这两种先验，而是将前馈几何模型（VGGT）的特征直接集成到2D分割基础模型（SAM）中，并进行端到端训练以实现跨视角实例预测。SAM-V引入了一种提示融合机制，通过视角特定的相机令牌和局部VGGT特征来丰富稀疏的SAM提示令牌（原文在此处截断）
tldr: SAM-V通过提示融合机制将前馈几何模型VGGT的特征直接集成到SAM分割基础模型中，端到端地实现几何感知的多视角一致实例分割，避免了事后掩码匹配带来的物体身份歧义问题。
en_tdlr: SAM-V directly integrates features from a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into the SAM foundation model via a prompt-fusion mechanism, enabling end-to-end geometry-aware multi-view instance segmentation without post-hoc mask matching.
